newsitem.title: USA: Nevada group launches campaign for $20 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: Nevada group launches campaign for $20 mln bond.

text.p: Supporters of a $20 million bond measure in Nevada to protect Lake Tahoe have launched a statewide campaign to win voter support.
The group, known as the Vote Yes on 12 Committee, said approval of Question 12 on the November 5 ballot would help to protect Lake Tahoe's water clarity.
Development around the lake has increased soil erosion and storm water runoff, resulting in a significant loss of water clarity, supporters of the measure said.
The bond funds would be used for wetland restoration, slope stabilization and storm water treatment.
The lake is located on the Nevada-California border.
The group said it has raised about $50,000 and was planning a television campaign in the two weeks before the election.
"We have broad support," said Stan Hansen, a Heavenly Ski Resort vice president and Question 12 supporter. "I know of no opposition right now."
